method: For each of the 154 city pages, pick the 6 nearest other city pages by great-circle (haversine) distance, using a mean Earth radius of 3,958.7613 miles, from U.S. Census Bureau 2026 Place Gazetteer internal points (INTPTLAT/INTPTLONG). Only cities that already have a Texas Homes Direct city page are included; do not add unlinked city names that have no page. Driving distance is not used for this ranking. The Census gazetteer name for Pecos is “Town of Pecos city” (GEOID 4873493); the on-page name stays Pecos.
